title: DBA risk score from two aggregates
description: Use at least two CTEs: one for active session counts by database_id and one for failed backup counts by database_id. For each database calculate risk_score = active_sessions * 2 + failed_backups * 3, treating missing values as zero. Return only databases with risk_score at least 5. Return exactly four columns: database_name, active_sessions, failed_backups, risk_score. Sort by risk_score DESC, then database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT database_id
  FROM sessions
),
failed AS (
  SELECT database_id
  FROM backups
)
SELECT
hints: Each CTE should aggregate only its own event type.
LEFT JOIN + COALESCE preserves a database that lacks one event category.
solution_explanation: Two pre-aggregations prevent sessions × backups row multiplication and produce the correct risk_score.
